category: torrent/NZB/URL fetcher that writes into the user's own cloud drive

free_tier.stated: Free account: 'You can download any amount of files less than 1.5 GB!' with 'Unlimited Speed/Transfers'.
free_tier.notes: unlimited count with a 1.5 GB per-file ceiling

per_object_cap.stated: 1.5 GB per file on the free account; paid caps are not stated on the page read.

retention.stated: The retrieved file is written into the user's own cloud account (Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Mega, pCloud, Amazon S3 and '25+ more'), so retention follows that account. No server-side retention figure is published.
retention.notes: the vendor's own copy is transient; the durable copy is the destination account

egress.terms: 'Unlimited Speed/Transfers' on the free account; no byte allowance is published on any plan. Egress for a user happens from the destination cloud, not from TransferCloud.
egress.free_allowance: not applicable: egress is billed by the destination cloud

interface_detail: web UI plus OAuth connections to 25+ cloud destinations; native FTP/SFTP/WebDAV pulls are also supported. No public API is documented on the page read.
tooling: browser; the destination cloud supplies the programmatic path (rclone, Drive API).
chaining: it also takes NZB, which makes it the cheapest way to move a usenet download into Drive.

limits.value: 1.5 GB per file on the free account

limits_note: plans start at $3.99/month but the paid per-file cap, job count and speed are not published on the landing page; the only numbers are the free 1.5 GB and the entry price.
binding_note: 1.5 GB rejects the 20 GiB case at the free tier, and the paid cap that would allow it is unpublished, so the record cannot say what the paid ceiling is.

identity_cost.detail: free account is an email plus a connected cloud account; paid plans from $3.99/month need a card.

reliability_note: the service inherits every failure of the destination cloud's OAuth and quota, and a 1.5 GB free cap means large torrents are impossible without paying.
confidence_note: the free-account sentence and the destination list were read today. Paid limits and retention are unpublished.

evidence.proved: 'Get a FREE account! - You can download any amount of files less than 1.5 GB!', 'Unlimited Speed/Transfers', destinations including Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Mega, pCloud and S3, NZB support, and 'Plans from $3.99/mo'

notes: The strongest 'writes into your own drive' option read, because it covers 25+ destinations and NZB as well as torrents. The free tier is capped at 1.5 GB per file, which is the same wall as every other free tier here.

extras.destinations: 25+ including Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Mega, pCloud, S3
